title: 1.4 Historical Issues and Contributors
description: Historical Issues and Contributors concepts and applications. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: During which period is classical physics said to have developed?
options: From the renaissance to the end of the nineteenth century
From the twentieth century onward as well in the textbook
Only in ancient Egypt now in the textbook of this subject
Only in the last fifty years for students in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: From the renaissance to the end of the nineteenth century

questions.question: What marks the start of modern physics?
options: Revolutionary discoveries at the beginning of the twentieth century
The invention of the wheel in class in the textbook of this subject
The founding of the first library now in this topic in the textbook
The discovery of farming in physics in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: Revolutionary discoveries at the beginning of the twentieth century

options: They were modified rather than discarded here

questions.question: Which achievement is associated with Faraday ten years after his 1821 result?
options: Converting magnetic force into electrical force
Discovering radioactivity still in the textbook

questions.correctAnswer: Converting magnetic force into electrical force

questions.question: Which statement about scientific knowledge over time is supported by the unit?
options: It grows through contributions from many scientists across eras

It changes only through political decisions now in the textbook
